integrity: Entire theorem and proofs are self-contained in RESULT.md; verify.py is a finite corroboration only. Full text of the 1994 multipartite bijection and the 2023 forest-containment article was not recovered; no independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The construction uses labeled, unweighted complete split graphs and b>=a-1. Rayleigh convergence requires a->infinity and b/a^2->infinity; joint Poisson limits require a^2/b->finite. Weighted multipartite generating identities and Cayley enumeration are previously known. Historical priority for the structural critical-window law is not independently certified.
title: Sharp total-variation Cayley-core approximation for split-graph spanning trees
